doctors.name: Dr. Pritesh S. Vidhate
doctors.bio: Leads clinical care at Shivraj Pet Clinic & Lab, with a focus on exotic animal medicine, soft tissue surgery and diagnostic ultrasonography. Known for thorough, patient consultations, honest evidence-based care, and as the vet Pune pet parents come to for second opinions.

doctors.name: Dr. Shivaji B. Vidhate
doctors.bio: Retired District Animal Husbandry Officer, Pune, with 33+ years of experience in field and companion animal medicine and surgery. He founded Shivraj Pet Clinic & Lab in 2013 and remains the clinic’s pathology anchor.

team.name: Mr. Deepak Joshi
team.bio: Known for gentle animal handling and a calm presence in the consultation room and operation theatre.
